g.text: Gondwana - Rendering Pipeline (CPU, Desktop GPU, Browser GPU)
Poll keyboard / mouse / touch / gamepad events
Advance tile animations and sprite movement
Render bitmap backbuffers on engine thread
Present bitmap backbuffers via UI adapters
Update engine FPS / CPS counters as due
Replay immutable commands to GPU canvas
Composite GPU backbuffer into platform framebuffer
Engine runs due simulation steps and CPU bitmap frames
Bitmap UI surface presents latest image
Begin paint and ensure GpuBackbuffer initialized
Engine.Tick() inside owning SKGLView paint callback
New scene frame needed or backbuffer recreated?
render scene and present to GPU canvas
Desktop GPU: three-slot immutable snapshot mailbox.
Browser GPU: SKGLView drives Tick, then renders on demand.
Window resizing and logical resolution are distinct.
